title: Records Retention Schedule
subtitle: Health and safety records, Gqeberha plant, approved 3 August 2026

blocks.p: This schedule sets, for every type of health and safety record we keep, why we keep it, where it is held, who may see it, how long we keep it and how we dispose of it. The Health and Safety Manager, Busisiwe Tshabalala, reviews it every year and whenever the law or our operations change.

Many of these records hold personal information about our employees, contractors and visitors. Under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), we collect and keep this information only to meet our health and safety duties under the OHS Act and COIDA and to protect the people on our site. We keep it no longer than the applicable rule requires or the practitioner sets, restrict access to the people named below, keep it secure and dispose of it safely. Medical records are held by the occupational health practitioner; our File holds only the fitness outcome (fit, fit with restrictions, unfit). Employees may ask to see their own records by writing to the Information Officer, Ruan de Villiers.

rows: Show how we meet the OHS Act
Cabinet HS1, Health and Safety office; scanned copy on the server
Written appointments, including the section 16(2) assignment
As the applicable rule or the practitioner sets
Risk assessments and safe work procedures
As the applicable rule or the practitioner sets
Confirm who is fit for which work
Human resources, the employee, the supervisor
As the applicable rule sets for the exposure
Monitor the health of exposed employees
Occupational health practitioner, never in our File
As the applicable regulations set for the hazard
Learn from incidents; report under COIDA
Know who is on site in an emergency
Security gate, then Health and Safety office

bullets: Paper records are kept in locked cabinets; only the people in the access column hold keys.
Electronic records are kept in folders with access limited to the same people, and the server is backed up.
No record is destroyed while an inspection, claim, investigation or legal matter about it is open.
Every disposal is recorded in the disposal log: record type, dates covered, method, date and the person who did it.
